title: Meeting notes
audience: For anyone who leaves meetings with messy notes and a vague sense of who does what.
description: Paste rough meeting notes or a transcript and your AI turns them into decisions and action items in Amber Notes.
tagline: Decisions and action items from every meeting.
seoTitle: Meeting notes to action items template for AI
note:
Meeting notes

After a meeting, paste your rough notes or the transcript into your AI. The summary and action items land here, newest meeting first.

## Open action items

## Meetings

prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Meeting notes". After a meeting I'll paste my rough notes or a transcript. Add a section at the start of "Meetings" with append_to_note (at_start): a "###" heading with the meeting name and date, a two-line summary, and the decisions as bullets. Add each action item under "Open action items" as a checklist line like "- [ ] Owner: task (due date)". If something is unclear, ask me before writing it. When I say an item is done, tick it with set_checklist_item.

asks: Here are my notes from the pricing sync: …
Mark Jonas's design review as done.

args.text:
- [ ] Sara: send the new pricing table to sales (Fri 2 Oct)
- [ ] Jonas: design review of the checkout page (Thu 1 Oct)
- [ ] Emma: check the VAT rules for Norway (next week)

### Pricing sync, 30 September
We keep three plans and drop the lifetime deal. The yearly discount goes from 20% to 15%.

- Decided: no lifetime plan.
- Decided: yearly discount is 15% from 1 November.
- Open: whether students get the Pro plan free.

args.item: Jonas: design review of the checkout page (Thu 1 Oct)
